buyer_summary: Primarily Director/VP/C-level eCommerce and digital marketing leaders at B2B manufacturers and distributors. Key titles include Director of eCommerce, VP/Head of Digital Marketing, CMO, Chief Digital Officer, and eCommerce Manager. Attendees come from industrial distribution, building materials, electrical, wholesale trade, food manufacturing, and specialty distribution companies. They are navigating digital commerce platform selection, PIM/data hygiene, ERP integration, AI-driven personalization, and omnichannel buyer experience. Decision-makers with budget for eCommerce platforms, PIM, OMS, AI tools, payment solutions, and digital agency/implementation partners.
